note: Issue #401: LAN play. One player hosts from F11 > Game, friends on the same wifi join by the host's address. Read by src/systems/net/net_session.gd. port: the UDP port the host listens on. max_players counts the host. send_rate: state packets a second each player sends. name_max: letters in a player's name. spawn_by_t89_m: how far from T-89 a guest stands on arrival. smooth_rate: how fast a remote body closes on where it was last heard (1/s); snap_m: further off than this it jumps. name_height: metres above the feet of the floating name. connect_timeout: seconds a join waits for the host before giving up. friendly_fire: your bolts and blade hurt the other players (each game applies the hits on its own player, times friendly_fire_scale); off, they pass through. hitbox_radius / hitbox_height: the other players' bodies, for shots and for walking into. outfit_check_s: how often each game looks whether you changed what you wear, and tells the others.

labels.host_left: The host left. You are on your own now.
